description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The enterprise ID, also known as the organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId].

description.zh: 工作项id，同workitemId，工作项唯一标识
description.en: The work item ID, which is the same as workitemId. It is the unique identifier of a work item.

title.zh: 关联文件为工作项的附件
title.en: Associate a file as a work item attachment
